scope: Manual verification checklists for benchmark images; not a manufacturing SOP approval
fallback: Hold screw in quarantine for manual verification of highlighted area; compare with calibrated reference.

manipulated_front.A: Inspect screw tip under 10× optical loupe; verify lead thread and point angle against calibrated template.
manipulated_front.B: Inspect screw tip outline under optical comparator from 90° rotated angle to verify tip symmetry.

scratch_head.A: Inspect screw head bearing surface and drive recess under 45° directional lighting for tooling burrs or cracks.
scratch_head.B: Verify drive socket engagement and head surface finish against reference master screw.

scratch_neck.A: Inspect underhead shank fillet under angled lighting for surface marks, notch stress risers, or galling.
scratch_neck.B: Verify shank diameter and underhead transition radius against specification tolerance.

thread_side.A: Inspect thread flanks under 45° directional shadow lighting; check for thread shearing or pitch galling.
thread_side.B: Inspect thread flank profile from 90° rotated angle; verify thread angle and pitch uniformity.

thread_top.A: Inspect thread crest under 10× optical loupe for crest flattening, micro-cracks, or height deviation.
thread_top.B: Verify major thread diameter and crest contour under shadow lighting against reference template.

unknown.A: Manually inspect highlighted area with optical comparator and compare against calibrated reference screw.
unknown.B: Verify image quality and part orientation in jig, then capture secondary angle frame for comparison.
